anomalies.description: SKU-1035 is a high-velocity SKU that stocks out because a purchase order was delivered 9 days late.
SKU-1002 has normal purchase orders but an abnormal spike in theft-reason shrinkage events, producing a shelf/backroom discrepancy.
SKU-1001 is a perishable SKU with a large batch expiring soon, causing an expiry-driven write-off and a subsequent stockout.
SKU-1003 sales suddenly doubled (promotion-like demand shift) in the last 60 days while its reorder_point stayed at the old level.
